_comment: One entry per model: context window, reasoning, and whatever else we learn
later. 'provider_defaults' applies to every model of a provider that has no
entry of its own; the provider key must match the label shown in the UI.
context_window — usable input+output tokens. Omitted means fall back to the
provider default, then to CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS.
reasoning — omitted means the model does not reason and nothing is sent.
param      'reasoning' sends {reasoning: {effort: X}}, 'reasoning_effort'
sends {reasoning_effort: X}.
efforts    literal values the provider accepts, in the order the UI shows
them. An EMPTY or missing list means the effort cannot be
steered: no control is offered and no parameter is sent.
default    sent when the user has not chosen. Omitting it sends nothing,
leaving the model at its own default — the safe choice, because
declaring a model must not change how it answers for anyone who
never touches the selector. Set one only to buy back cost or
latency we do not need.
mandatory  the model reasons whether or not it is asked to, so its trace
is shown (collapsed) rather than discarded. A mandatory model
may not list 'none'/'off' among its efforts; the loader strips
them, because a switch that cannot work is worse than no switch.
note       for humans only; never parsed, never sent.
Probed 2026-08-22 against ai.ufal and OpenRouter — see the notes below.
The short version: OpenRouter honours the parameter; the ai.ufal Open WebUI
gateway silently drops it on every endpoint, so every ai.ufal model runs at
its own built-in default and declares no efforts.
The MLX-backed Nemotrons report no context length and we have not measured
one, so they deliberately have no context_window and fall back to the AI Ufal
provider default. Guessing high risks overflowing the served slot.

reasoning.note: OpenRouter. Probed 2026-08-22: the model self-reports the level we ask for and the trace length tracks it. 'none' is a 400 — 'Reasoning is mandatory for this endpoint and cannot be disabled' — and shipping it here broke every answer from this model until 2026-08-23.

ai.ufal. Reasons always, returns reasoning_content. reasoning_effort is dropped by the gateway (the model self-reports 'Reasoning: medium' whatever we send, on /api, /api/v1 and /openai), so no control is offered. Upstream it would accept low/medium/high and cannot be turned off.

ai.ufal. Reasons always, returns reasoning_content — including when asked for 'off'. At temperature 0 all of off/low/medium/high/xhigh produce byte-identical output, so the gateway drops the parameter. Upstream Qwen3.6 would accept off/low/medium/high/xhigh.
ai.ufal. Reasons always, returns reasoning_content — 'off' still produced a full trace. Upstream Nemotron would accept off/low/medium/high.
ai.ufal. Reasons always, returns reasoning_content; trace was identical for none/off/high.
